summary: Live dogfood must use safe realistic inputs, treat empty lookup results honestly, and distinguish optional Square product capabilities from the core API surface.
reason: Square rejects empty search bodies, some lookups validly return empty success, and Sandbox accounts can lack appointments, loyalty, channels, online checkout, or reporting. Without command-level dogfood metadata, the release gate reports false CLI defects or probes unavailable account capabilities.
validated_outcome: Full Square Sandbox live dogfood passed 774 of 774 executed probes with zero failures; 907 unsafe, fixture-blocked, or capability-mismatched probes were explicitly skipped.
